facts.statement: SMSRoute account signup requires only an email address; no ID document, phone number, or company registration is collected.
SMSRoute accepts six cryptocurrencies for payment: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), Monero (XMR), Litecoin (LTC), and Solana (SOL).
SMSRoute's advertised base price is $0.004 per message part; per-destination rates are published on the live price table.
SMSRoute delivers SMS to 149 countries.
New SMSRoute accounts receive free test credits, so delivery can be verified with a real message before any payment.
SMSRoute shows per-message delivery status on screen, confirming whether a message reached the handset.
SMSRoute supports alphanumeric sender names on request in markets that deliver them; the United States and Canada terminate texts from numeric senders only.
Branded A2P sending over United States 10-digit long codes requires 10DLC registration; toll-free and short-code sending have their own separate registration regimes.
A plain-text SMS using the GSM-7 alphabet holds 160 characters in one message, or 153 characters per part when it splits.
An SMS containing any emoji or non-GSM-7 character switches to Unicode encoding and holds 70 characters, or 67 per part when it splits.
SMS itself is not end-to-end encrypted; SMSRoute's anonymity applies at the account and billing layer, not the carrier network.
